lines.en: label iospring2:
scene clearnightsky
There is no second half of “My Indigo.”
lines.zh: 《我的靛蓝》没有下半部分。

lines.en: It’s one of those poems that comes and goes — like sunlight in the afternoon when it finds the gaps between leaves and squeezes through them, spilling itself out onto the asphalt.
lines.zh: 它属于那种来了又走的诗——就像午后的阳光，找到树叶之间的缝隙，从缝隙里挤过去，洒落在沥青路面上。

lines.en: I often wonder how {i}I{/i} would look splayed out upon the asphalt, but the manner in which I envision that is a lot less aesthetically pleasing.
lines.zh: 我常常好奇{i}自己{/i}摊开在沥青路面上会是什么样子，但我想象中的那个画面，可就没那么有美感了。

lines.en: We’re heading back to the bathhouse, I think. Or some other place that Io wants to go, but she hasn’t said much ever since leaving the restaurant and I don’t think it’s safe to ask her.
lines.zh: 我们正在回澡堂，我想。或者是 Io 想去的别的什么地方——不过离开餐厅之后她就没怎么说过话，我觉得还是别问为妙。

lines.en: It goes without saying, but she reminds me of myself sometimes. Especially when her voice fades out.
lines.zh: 这不用说，但她有时候会让我想起我自己。尤其是她的声音渐渐消失的时候。

lines.en: So as the moon attempts to mimic the sun and cast its light through the trees, this is what I’m thinking of.
lines.zh: 所以当月亮试图模仿太阳、把它的光洒过树梢时，我想到的就是这些。

lines.en: But the differences between Io and me are just as noticeable as that of the sun and the moon.
lines.zh: 可 Io 和我之间的差别，也和太阳与月亮的差别一样显而易见。

lines.en: One of us is stronger, one of us is weaker. But neither one of us can agree on which is which. Which is fine, because it creates just enough space between the two of us that she’ll feel safe.
lines.zh: 我们中有一个更强，有一个更弱。但我们俩始终无法就「谁强谁弱」达成一致。这也没关系，因为这样正好在我们之间留出了足够的空间，让她能感到安心。

lines.en: And so I keep my distance-
lines.zh: 于是我保持着距离——

lines.en: But I long to go for a swim.
lines.zh: 可我渴望去游个泳。

lines.en: I’m sure when I was younger, there were times I wanted something I couldn’t have. And given that I still possess the mental maturity of a child at times, I should be okay with this. I should be able to adapt.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，在我更小的时候，也有过想要却得不到的东西。既然我至今在某些时候还保有孩童般的心智成熟度，我应该能接受才对。我应该能适应。

lines.en: I should be okay with keeping my swim trunks locked in the drawer until the setting is right and the sun has no tree to meld with.
lines.zh: 我应该能接受把泳裤锁在抽屉里，直到时机合适、直到太阳再没有树可以与它交融。

lines.en: But I {i}really{/i} want to go for a swim.
lines.zh: 但我{i}真的{/i}很想去游个泳。

lines.en: And I want to take her with me.
lines.zh: 而且我想带她一起去。

lines.en: : Sorry for being stupid again. I left my safety net at home.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我又犯蠢了。我把我的安全网落在家里了。

lines.en: : The one with Uta or the one with naked people? Because I’m not really sure where we’re headed right now.
lines.zh: : 是有 Uta 的那张，还是有裸体的人的那张？因为我真的不确定我们现在要往哪儿走。

lines.en: : The latter. I haven’t really been staying at the dorm as much as I used to lately.
lines.zh: : 后者。最近我不怎么住校了，不像以前那样。

lines.en: : Any reason why?
lines.zh: : 有什么原因吗？

lines.en: : I just don’t like girls very much.
lines.zh: : 我只是不太喜欢女生。

lines.en: : Wow, really? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 哇，真的吗？我完全看不出来。

lines.en: : How do you do it, Sensei? Or...how {i}did{/i} you do it before you too learned to appreciate just how great it is to live a life of mostly solitude?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么{i}做到{/i}的，Sensei？或者……在你也学会欣赏这种大半时间独处的生活有多美妙之前，你是怎么做到的？

lines.en: : I’m sure my sexual attraction to them played some sort of role in keeping me sane.
lines.zh: : 我猜，我对她们的性吸引力，在维持我神志正常这件事上起到了某种作用。

lines.en: : Does it really make that much of a difference?
lines.zh: : 那真的有那么大的区别吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. I’ve never really thought about it.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我还真没怎么想过。

lines.en: : I’ve just never spent much time around other guys, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，我好像也没怎么在别的男生身边待过。

lines.en: : Even when you were younger?
lines.zh: : 你小时候也是吗？

lines.en: : All I remember from when I was younger is my childhood friend who, and you might want to brace yourself for this, was also a girl.
lines.zh: : 我对小时候的全部记忆，就只有我那个青梅竹马——你最好先做好心理准备——也是个女生。

lines.en: : Why would I have to brace myself for such a predictable thing?
lines.zh: : 这么意料之中的事，我为什么要做心理准备？

lines.en: : You just get so jealous any time another girl comes up that I figured hearing about such a fated connection might hurt your feelings.
lines.zh: : 你每次一提到别的女生就吃醋得不行，所以我想，听到这么一段命中注定的羁绊，可能会伤到你的感情。

lines.en: : Is she important to you?
lines.zh: : 她对你很重要吗？

lines.en: : In a lot of ways, she’s the {i}most{/i} important person to me.
lines.zh: : 在很多方面，她都是对我来说{i}最{/i}重要的人。

lines.en: : And in others?
lines.zh: : 在别的方面呢？

lines.en: scene black
: In other ways, part of me wishes she didn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 在别的方面，我有一部分希望她从来没有存在过。

lines.en: scene komorebi1
We make our way into Io’s room because of course we do. We were {i}always{/i} going to come here whether I knew it deep down or not because {i}this{/i} is where she’s safest.
lines.zh: 我们走进 Io 的房间，因为理所当然会这样。不管我内心深处是否清楚，我们{i}终究{/i}会来到这里——因为{i}这里{/i}是她最安全的地方。

lines.en: Not next to me. Not next to Uta. But in a room surrounded by wooden robots and tools and pills and wires and even more pills and everything else that serves as her {i}safety net.{/i}
lines.zh: 不是在我身边。不是在 Uta 身边。而是在一个被木头机器人、工具、药片、电线，还有更多药片，以及一切充当她{i}安全网{/i}的东西包围的房间里。

lines.en: The air is different this time around — and it’s not just because I’m not waking up in some gaudy bathrobe and faux-fur pajama pants.
lines.zh: 这次的空气不太一样——倒不只是因为我没有穿着那件俗气的浴袍和仿毛皮睡裤醒来。

lines.en: Maybe it’s the light — and that stale scent of turpentine— or the fact that I am dangerously conscious for the time being.
lines.zh: 也许是光线的关系——还有那股松节油的陈味——又或者只是因为我现在清醒得有些危险。

lines.en: Whatever it is, it makes me want to fall asleep and never get up.
lines.zh: 不管是什么，它都让我想一睡不起。

lines.en: I want to collapse in her bed, fall asleep in her arms, then awake and brush her hair out of her face before going home and getting scolded by my {i}daughter.{/i}
lines.zh: 我想瘫倒在她的床上，在她的怀里睡着，醒来后把她脸上的头发拨开，然后回家挨我{i}女儿{/i}一顿骂。

lines.en: But this is someone else’s daughter. And yes, that’s true of every girl I crawl into bed with, but you know what I mean.
lines.zh: 可这是别人的女儿。没错，我爬上床的每一个女孩都是别人家的女儿，但你懂我的意思。

lines.en: The idea of something so pure and innocent is antithetical to the evils at play here. So again, I keep my distance.
lines.zh: 如此纯粹、如此天真的念头，与此处横行的种种罪恶格格不入。所以，我再一次保持着距离。

lines.en: Again I recite “My Indigo.” But I keep stopping at the line “blackness gathers in the grass” and worry that the grass is {i}here{/i} and that {i}I{/i} am the blackness.
lines.zh: 我再一次背诵《我的靛蓝》。可我总是停在「黑暗在草丛中聚拢」那一句，然后开始担心——草就在{i}这里{/i}，而{i}我{/i}是那片黑暗。

lines.en: I’m sure that’s not what Lee had in mind when he wrote this poem. My existence matters not to him, nor anyone else with a brain even half as functional.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，Lee 写下这首诗的时候，脑子里绝没有想到这个。我的存在对他毫无意义，对任何一个大脑功能哪怕只有一半好使的人来说也一样。

lines.en: But Io’s brain is held together by glue and benzodiazepines, and it isn’t strong enough to protect its container from the blue death.
lines.zh: 可 Io 的大脑是靠胶水和苯二氮卓类粘在一起的，它根本不够结实，保护不了它的容器免受那场蓝色死亡的侵袭。

lines.en: I really want to go swimming.
lines.zh: 我真的很想去游泳。

lines.en: : You haven’t been here since you accidentally flashed Uta, have you?
lines.zh: : 自从你不小心走光给 Uta 看了之后，你就没再来过这儿吧？

lines.en: : Not unless the two of you dragged me here after breaking into my house. But that whole night is blurry to me and I don’t think either one of you is strong enough.
lines.zh: : 除非你们俩闯进我家之后把我拖到了这里。不过那一整晚对我来说都很模糊，而且我觉得你们俩谁都没那么大力气。

lines.en: scene komorebi2
: We kind of just showed up, freaked out, then got forced out of the house by your psychopath of a niece.
lines.zh: : 我们基本上就是来了，吓坏了，然后被你那个疯子侄女赶出了屋子。

lines.en: : I’m sure she was just trying to protect me.
lines.zh: : 我相信她只是想保护我。

lines.en: scene komorebi3
: So does that give {i}other{/i} people permission to capture you and hold you in captivity so long as they’re doing it out of what you’d call “the goodness of their heart?” Asking for a friend.
lines.zh: : 那是不是就意味着，只要{i}别人{/i}是出于你所谓的「一片好心」，他们就有权把你抓起来囚禁？替朋友问的。

lines.en: : My answer to that question hinges entirely on whether or not you have a pair of handcuffs in this room.
lines.zh: : 我对这个问题的回答，完全取决于你这房间里有没有一副手铐。

lines.en: : And now I’m even more confused because I can’t tell if you {i}want{/i} me to have handcuffs or not and I don’t want to say the wrong thing.
lines.zh: : 现在我更糊涂了，因为我分不清你是{i}希望{/i}我有手铐还是不希望，而我不想说错话。

lines.en: scene komorebi4
: Do you want to keep me here forever?
lines.zh: : 你想把我永远留在这儿吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. It sounds nice and all, but it also might make it really hard to go to the amusement park when you finally decide to take me there.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。听起来挺不错，但这样一来，等你终于决定带我去游乐园的时候，可能会变得很麻烦。

lines.en: : Let’s go soon.
lines.zh: : 我们很快就去吧。

lines.en: scene komorebi5
: Really?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s not like I have anything else going on anymore. And I’ve already been there with Tsuneyo twice since first talking to you about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。反正我也没什么别的事可做了。而且自从第一次跟你提过之后，我已经和 Tsuneyo 去过两次了。

lines.en: : I’m just going to ignore that last part so I can continue to be excited! Heck yeah! Amusement park!
lines.zh: : 我决定把最后那半句忽略掉，好让我继续兴奋下去！太棒了！游乐园！

lines.en: : Don’t get {i}too{/i} excited. The fact that it’s an amusement park won’t change the fact that I will continue to be completely unamusing while inside it.
lines.zh: : 别{i}太{/i}兴奋。就算那是游乐园，也改变不了我在里面依旧会无聊透顶这件事。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter! I suck too, which just means that we can suck together while participating in slightly less sucky activities!
lines.zh: : 不要紧！我也很烂，那正好意味着我们可以一起烂，同时参与一些没那么烂的活动！

lines.en: scene komorebi6
: Works for me, Io.
lines.zh: : 我没意见，Io。

lines.en: : Sensei? Where are you going?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Bed. I’m tired.
lines.zh: : 床上。我累了。

lines.en: scene komorebi7
: But we just got here.
lines.zh: : 可我们才刚到啊。

lines.en: : We did. Which means you’re welcome to join me if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 是啊。所以你要是想一起，随时欢迎。

lines.en: : You’re giving me permission to enter my own bed?
lines.zh: : 你在允许我进我自己的床？

lines.en: : That’s right. I’ve seized control of it. This is my bed now.
lines.zh: : 没错。我已经把它占领了。现在这是我的床。

lines.en: scene komorebi8
: You’re allowed to do that?!
lines.zh: : 你还能这么干？！

lines.en: : We can do anything we want. That’s what it means to be free.
lines.zh: : 我们想干什么都行。这就是自由的意义。

lines.en: : Then I hereby seize control of your heart and command that you leave behind however many fake girlfriends you have in favor of either me or Uta! Or both.
lines.zh: : 那我在此占领你的心，并命令你抛弃你那些假女朋友——不管有几个——换成我或者 Uta！或者两个都要。

lines.en: : Can I bring Ami along?
lines.zh: : 我能带上 Ami 吗？

lines.en: scene komorebi9
: Ew, no. I’ll never get to see you if she’s there. She’s too clingy.
lines.zh: : 恶，不行。她在的话我就永远见不到你了。她太黏人了。

lines.en: : And you’re not?
lines.zh: : 而你不黏人？

lines.en: : Not like {i}that.{/i} She’s genuinely creepy. I’m just annoying.
lines.zh: : 我{i}那种{/i}不算。她是真的让人发毛。我只是烦人而已。

lines.en: : She’s family, Io. I can’t just abandon her even if you {i}do{/i} seize control of my heart.
lines.zh: : 她是家人啊，Io。{i}就算{/i}你占领了我的心，我也不能就这么抛下她。

lines.en: scene komorebi10
: Then what good does seizing it even do in the first place? Besides, isn’t it sort of arbitrary to keep her close-by just because she’s “family?” That word means literally nothing.
lines.zh: : 那占领它到底有什么用？再说了，仅仅因为她是「家人」就把她留在身边，是不是有点武断？这个词根本毫无意义。

lines.en: : This is your aunt’s house, isn’t it? If family meant nothing, you’d be back at the dorms right now.
lines.zh: : 这是你姑姑的家，不是吗？要是家人毫无意义，你现在就该回宿舍了。

lines.en: : I’m not here for my aunt. I’m here because this is where all of my stuff is.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿不是为了我姑姑。我来这儿是因为我所有的东西都在这儿。

lines.en: : But your stuff wouldn’t {i}be{/i} here without your aunt is what I’m saying. Which, by extension, means we never would have met without her.
lines.zh: : 但我的意思是，没有你姑姑，你的东西也{i}不会{/i}在这儿。推而广之，没有她，我们也就永远不会相遇。

lines.en: : And, speaking of which, when {i}am{/i} I going to meet her? Because I’ve been coming here for a while now and she’s never even-
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我{i}什么时候{/i}能见见她？我都来这儿这么久了，她却从来没——

lines.en: scene komorebi11
: She travels a lot.
lines.zh: : 她经常出差。

lines.en: : Where? She can’t leave the city.
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？她又不能离开这座城市。

lines.en: : Around? I don’t know. It’s a big city. And you’d have nothing to gain from meeting her anyway.
lines.zh: : 到处跑？我不知道。这城市挺大的。再说了，你见她也没什么好处。

lines.en: : It’s not really about gaining anything, it’s about putting a face to a name.
lines.zh: : 这跟有没有好处没关系，只是想给一个名字配上一张脸。

lines.en: : You don’t even know her name, though.
lines.zh: : 可你连她的名字都不知道啊。

lines.en: : Do you not {i}want{/i} me meeting her or something?
lines.zh: : 你是有什么理由不{i}想{/i}让我见她吗？

lines.en: scene komorebi12
: Was that not immediately obvious?
lines.zh: : 这难道不是显而易见的吗？

lines.en: : It...was. I just don’t really get why.
lines.zh: : 是……是挺明显的。我只是不太明白为什么。

lines.en: : Because I want to keep my life with you separate from my life outside of you.
lines.zh: : 因为我想把我跟你在一起的生活，和我之外的生活分开。

lines.en: : That’s not really how having a life with someone works, Io. You can’t just hide things from me forever.
lines.zh: : 和一个人共同生活不是这么回事，Io。你不可能永远对我藏着掖着。

lines.en: : Sure I can. But that’s fine because it means you can also hide things from me, so we don’t accidentally start mixing traumas and make our relationship all messy and sad like everything else in our lives.
lines.zh: : 我当然能。不过这也挺好的，因为这意味着你也可以对我藏着掖着，这样我们就不会不小心把各自的创伤搅在一起，把我们的关系弄得跟生活里其他事情一样又乱又丧。

lines.en: : But what if I want to share something with you?
lines.zh: : 可要是我想跟你分享什么呢？

lines.en: : Then you can. I just don’t want it to be mandatory.
lines.zh: : 那你可以分享。我只是不希望它变成强制的。

lines.en: : I’m not proposing we make it “mandatory.” I’m proposing that-
lines.zh: : 我又没提议把它变成「强制」。我提议的是——

lines.en: : If you meet her, you’ll meet her. If you don’t, you won’t. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 你要是见她，就会见到。见不到，就见不到。就这么简单。

lines.en: : It’s not like you’re missing out anything. She’s just some random woman with really bad fashion sense.
lines.zh: : 你也没错过什么。她不过是个品味糟糕透顶的普通女人。

lines.en: scene komorebi13
: She’s more than just “some woman.” She’s the person effectively raising you. And if she isn’t doing anything wrong, it’s messed up to just {i}reduce{/i} her to that.
lines.zh: : 她不只是「某个女人」。她是实际把你养大的人。如果她没做错什么，那把她{i}贬{/i}得这么轻就很过分。

lines.en: : How is it messed up? It’s not like I’m calling her an evil bitch. I’m just saying she is a human being who exists and that you don’t have a good reason to meet her. Which is true.
lines.zh: : 哪里过分了？我又没骂她是恶毒的贱人。我只是说她是个存在着的人，而你没有充分的理由去见她。这是事实。

lines.en: : You’re right. That {i}is{/i} true. I don’t have to meet her. I’ve gotten along just fine without her and I am perfectly content never coming into contact with a woman whose clothes I wore.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。{i}确实{/i}是事实。我不必见她。没有她我也过得挺好的，而且我完全满足于永远不去接触一个——我穿过的衣服都属于她的女人。

lines.en: : But, as someone currently reevaluating just what it means to be part of a “family,” I have a problem with you talking about her like that.
lines.zh: : 但是，作为一个正在重新审视「成为一家人」到底意味着什么的人，我对你那样谈论她有意见。

lines.en: : Like what? Again, I said literally nothing bad about her. She’s just there.
lines.zh: : 哪样？再说一遍，我可一句坏话都没说。她就是在那儿而已。

lines.en: scene komorebi14
: Do you have any idea how hard “just being there” is?
lines.zh: : 你知道「就在那儿」有多难吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}not{/i} hard? Because it is literally as simple as “just being there.” Which is like, the bare minimum amount of activity required to participate in something.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}不{/i}难吧？因为「就在那儿」字面上就是这么简单。这几乎是参与一件事所需要的最低限度的行动了。

lines.en: : Just look at how I’ve acted at essentially every single class gathering that we’ve ever-
lines.zh: : 看看我在我们每一次班级聚会上的表现就——

lines.en: : Just being there as a person is way different than just being there as a parent.
lines.zh: : 作为一个人「就在那儿」，和作为家长「就在那儿」，完全是两码事。

lines.en: : Cool. Except she {i}isn’t{/i} a parent. She’s my {i}aunt.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好酷哦。可她又{i}不是{/i}家长。她是我{i}姑姑{/i}。

lines.en: : Is she there for you when you need her? Does she give you a place to live and food to eat? Who’s the one refilling all of your prescriptions? Who is giving you money?
lines.zh: : 你需要她的时候她在你身边吗？她给你住的地方、给你饭吃吗？是谁一直在给你续那些处方药？是谁在给你钱？

lines.en: : She is, but-
lines.zh: : 是她，但是——

lines.en: : Then she’s a parent. She’s your mother.
lines.zh: : 那她就是家长。她就是你妈。

lines.en: scene komorebi15
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Maybe I was wrong when I asked you if you knew how hard it was to “just be there.” What I should have asked is if you know how easy it is to fuck that up.
lines.zh: : 也许我刚才问你知不知道「就在那儿」有多难，是问错了。我应该问的是，你知不知道把这件事搞砸有多容易。

lines.en: : You have a problem with Ami, right? Well, the reason she’s like that is because of me. It’s because {i}I{/i} wasn’t there that she’s all fucked up now. So if you’re going to blame anyone, blame me for that. Not her.
lines.zh: : 你对 Ami 有意见，对吧？她之所以变成现在这样，是因为我。是因为{i}我{/i}当时不在，她现在才一团糟。所以你要怪就怪我，别怪她。

lines.en: : What’s going on with you? Why are you getting so beaten up over this? Are you just {i}trying{/i} to start a fight with me or something?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么了？为什么要为这件事这么较劲？你就是{i}想{/i}跟我吵一架还是怎么的？

lines.en: : What’s going on is that I think you’re taking your aunt for granted and that isn’t fair to her. She doesn’t {i}have{/i} to look after you, but she does. And she gives you everything you need, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 我是觉得你把姑姑的付出当成了理所当然，这对她不公平。她{i}没有{/i}义务照顾你，可她照顾了。而且她给了你一切需要的东西，不是吗？

lines.en: : I could look after myself if I had to. That’s basically what I do anyway.
lines.zh: : 如果有必要，我自己也能照顾自己。反正我基本上就是这么过来的。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good for you. But not everyone can do that. And if Ami had someone like her instead of someone like me, maybe fewer people would hate her for what she’s become.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那对你来说挺好。但不是每个人都能做到。如果 Ami 身边有个像她那样的人，而不是像我这样的人，也许就不会有那么多人因为她变成现在这副样子而讨厌她。

lines.en: : Oh, so it’s a {i}personal{/i} thing. You’re coming after me because you regret things {i}you{/i} have done. Got it. That’s fine. I’ll be a scapegoat if it makes you feel better, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦，原来是{i}私人{/i}恩怨啊。你冲我来，是因为{i}你{/i}在后悔自己做过的事。明白了。没关系。如果能让你好受些，我当替罪羊就是了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to come after you, Io. I just-
lines.zh: : 我不是要冲你来，Io。我只是——

lines.en: scene komorebi16
: You just want to tell me how I’m supposed to look at family because you’re pretending to be more than just Ami’s uncle now, right? And you want to feel better about the job you’re doing!
lines.zh: : 你只是想告诉我该怎么看待家人，因为你现在正假装自己不只是 Ami 的叔叔了，对吧？你想对自己正在做的这份工作感觉好一点！

lines.en: : Right?!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！

lines.en: : You’re not entirely off-base, but you’re not entirely correct either.
lines.zh: : 你也不算完全没道理，但也不算完全正确。

lines.en: : Well I think it’s {i}cute{/i} that you want to play dress-up, Sensei! But maybe you should pretend to be something {i}other{/i} than a parent because parents fucking suck and you don’t want to be one!
lines.zh: : 哎，我觉得你想玩过家家还挺{i}可爱{/i}的，Sensei！不过你也许该假装成{i}别的什么{/i}，别装家长，因为家长都他妈的烂透了，你可不想当家长！

lines.en: : You’re right. I don’t {i}want{/i} to be one. I {i}have{/i} to be one or Ami is going to-
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我不{i}想{/i}当。我{i}必须{/i}当，否则 Ami 会——

lines.en: : There’s no fixing that girl, Sensei. Just like there’s no fixing me! And I already {i}have{/i} an extended relative who inherited a role that, based on my experience, gets way more credit than it should for literally nothing!
lines.zh: : 那个女孩没救了，Sensei。就像我也没救了一样！而且我{i}已经{/i}有一个远房亲戚继承了一个角色，而根据我的经验，那个角色明明什么都没做，却得到了远超它应得的赞誉！

lines.en: scene komorebi14
: I’ll never get this fascination people have with {i}family.{/i} Like, oh! Congrats on having similar DNA structure to someone else! You guys must really love each other!
lines.zh: : 我永远搞不懂人们对{i}家庭{/i}的这份执念。就好比，哦！恭喜你们和另一个人有相似的 DNA 结构！你们一定真的很爱彼此！

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Shut up! I’m not finished! I need to tell you how fucking {i}stupid{/i} this topic is so we can go back to liking each other!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我还没说完！我得告诉你这个话题有多他妈的{i}愚蠢{/i}，这样我们才能回到互相喜欢的样子！

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : I said shut up!
lines.zh: : 我叫你闭嘴！

lines.en: scene komorebi17
: I don’t give a single FUCK about what you want to be or what you think you {i}are,{/i} just keep me out of it!
lines.zh: : 你想成为什么、你以为自己{i}是{/i}什么，我一个他妈的都不在乎，别把我扯进去就行！

lines.en: : I don’t {b}NEED{/b} family and I don’t {b}NEED{/b} to be reminded of how {b}EASY IT IS{/b} to fuck up just {b}EXISTING,{/b} okay?!
lines.zh: : 我根本{b}不需要{/b}家人，我也根本{b}不需要{/b}被人提醒，仅仅是「{b}存在着{/b}」就有多{b}容易{/b}搞砸，明白吗？！

lines.en: : Parents have {b}ONE FUCKING JOB{/b} and it’s to {b}BE THERE.{/b} It isn’t hard! It’s really not! And I don’t {b}CARE{/b} that I’ve never experienced what it’s like on their end because I don’t {b}HAVE{/b} to!
lines.zh: : 父母只有他妈的{b}一件事{/b}要做，那就是「{b}在、那、儿{/b}」。这不难！真的不难！而且我不{b}在乎{/b}自己从来没有体验过他们那一端是什么感觉，因为我{b}不需要{/b}！

lines.en: : And here {b}YOU{/i} are, playing a game of charades where you get to act out the role of a {b}FATHER{/b} for the first time in your life, and you want {b}ME{/b} to be thankful for {b}SOMEONE ELSE{/b} playing too?!
lines.zh: : 而{b}你现在{/b}就在这里玩着一场猜字谜的游戏，人生中第一次扮演起「{b}父亲{/b}」的角色，然后你还想让{b}我{/b}对{b}另一个{/b}同样在扮演这个角色的人心怀感激？！

lines.en: : Are you an {b}IDIOT?{/b} Are you {b}STUPID?!{/b} Or do you just {b}HATE{/i} kids and get joy out of inflicting pain on them?! Is {b}THAT{/b} why you’re doing this?! Is that your end goal here?! Are you one of {b}THEM{/b} now?!
lines.zh: : 你是{b}白痴{/b}吗？你是{b}蠢货{/b}吗？！还是说你就是{b}讨厌{/b}小孩，从伤害他们当中获得快感？！{b}这{/b}就是你这么做的理由吗？！这就是你的最终目的吗？！你现在也变成{b}他们{/b}那样的人了吗？！

lines.en: : Of course not...
lines.zh: : 当然不是……

lines.en: : Then {b}WHY?!{/b} Why would you press me about this?! Why would you call my {b}AUNT{/b} such a {b}TERRIBLE{/b} thing to my face?!
lines.zh: : 那{b}为什么{/b}？！你为什么要在这件事上逼我？！为什么要当着我的面，用那么{b}难听{/b}的话称呼我的{b}姑姑{/b}？！

lines.en: : You {b}DID{/i} hear, didn’t you?! {b}YOU HEARD WHAT THEY SAID ABOUT ME!{/b} That I’m {b}ROTTEN! SPENT! TRASH!{/b}
lines.zh: : 你{b}听到{/b}了，对吧？！{b}你听到他们是怎么说我的了{/b}！说我{b}烂透了！废品！垃圾{/b}！

lines.en: scene komorebi18
: And you know it’s true...
lines.zh: : 而你知道那是真的……

lines.en: : But you have no idea what it’s like.
lines.zh: : 可你根本不知道那是什么感觉。

lines.en: : You’ve never felt like a prisoner...even when you {i}were{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有觉得自己是个囚犯……哪怕你真的{i}曾经是{/i}。

lines.en: : You’ve never seen your home as a jail cell. Never had your cries for help ignored by everyone around you.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有把自己的家看成一间牢房。从来没有在呼救时被周围所有人无视。

lines.en: : Never had to make up stories and excuses about why you’d have panic attacks in the middle of school! And why they weren’t anything for someone to be concerned about! But they were!
lines.zh: : 从来没有为了解释自己为什么会在学校里突然惊恐发作而编造故事和借口！还要解释为什么那些根本不值得别人在意！可它们明明值得！

lines.en: : Someone should have done something! {b}SOMEONE SHOULD HAVE HELPED ME!{/b} But they didn’t! No one did! Not until the damage had already been done!
lines.zh: : 本来应该有人做点什么的！{b}本来应该有人帮帮我{/b}的！可他们没有！一个人都没有！直到伤害已经造成！

lines.en: : Are {b}THOSE{/b} the people you want me to feel sorry for?! The ones who let a little girl {b}ROT{/b} and {b}BREAK{/b} because {b}THEY{/b} had kids of their own?! Or the ones who {b}BROKE ME{/b} in the first place?!
lines.zh: : {b}那些{/b}人就是你希望我去同情的人吗？！那些让一个小女孩{b}腐烂{/b}、{b}崩溃{/b}，只因为{b}他们{/b}自己有孩子要养的人？！还是那些从一开始就{b}把我弄坏{/b}的人？！

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} no parents. Not anymore.
lines.zh: : 我{i}没有{/i}父母。已经没有了。

lines.en: : I have an aunt and that’s it.
lines.zh: : 我有一个姑姑，仅此而已。

lines.en: : And if you want me to start seeing her as anything else, you should grab me a bucket because I can’t even say the word “Mom” without wanting to throw up.
lines.zh: : 而如果你想让我开始把她看成别的什么，你最好给我拿个桶来，因为光是说出「妈妈」这个词，我就想吐。

lines.en: scene komorebi19
: Do you want to know how old I was?
lines.zh: : 你想知道我那时候多大吗？

lines.en: : Are you just lying to me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在骗我吗？

lines.en: : Then what were you doing with that picture of Uta?
lines.zh: : 那你拿着那张 Uta 的照片在干什么？

lines.en: scene komorebi20
: What...picture of Uta?...
lines.zh: : 什么……Uta 的照片？……

lines.en: : You know exactly what I’m talking about...
lines.zh: : 你很清楚我在说什么……

lines.en: : It wasn’t just a misunderstanding...that was all typical wishful thinking from typical Io...
lines.zh: : 那根本不是什么误解……那全都是典型的 Io 式的一厢情愿……

lines.en: : I mean...what’s there to even misunderstand? You’re just another sick adult who can’t control himself around little girls. And I’m so fucked up by now that it barely even bothers me anymore when it comes to {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……到底有什么可误解的？你不过是又一个管不住自己、对小女孩下手的恶心大人。而到了现在，我已经烂成这样，轮到{i}我自己{/i}身上时，这种事几乎都让我懒得在意了。

lines.en: : But Uta...
lines.zh: : 可 Uta……

lines.en: : Those pictures ruined her life.
lines.zh: : 那些照片毁了她的人生。

lines.en: : And you’re keeping one as a...fucking trophy.
lines.zh: : 而你还留着一张当……他妈的战利品。

lines.en: : How...did you even...
lines.zh: : 你是……怎么……

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter...Nothing matters...I’m done...
lines.zh: : 无所谓了……什么都不重要了……我放弃了……

lines.en: : Done with {i}what,{/i} Io?...
lines.zh: : 放弃{i}什么{/i}，Io？……

lines.en: : Everything.
lines.zh: : 一切。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want to me. I won’t fight back.
lines.zh: : 你想对我做什么就做什么吧。我不会反抗的。

lines.en: scene komorebi21
: Did you hear that, Aki-kun? She says she won’t fight back. Sounds like consent to me.
lines.zh: : 听到了吗，Aki 君？她说她不会反抗。在我听来，这就是同意了。

lines.en: : My Indigo...
lines.zh: : 我的靛蓝……

lines.en: scene komorebi22
: Hm?
: I've come to find the flower which blossoms...like a saint dying upside down...
lines.zh: : 我前来寻找那朵绽放得……像倒悬而死的圣徒一般的花……

lines.en: scene komorebi23
: The rose won't do, nor the iris. I've come to find the moody one, the shy one, downcast, grave, and isolated...
lines.zh: : 玫瑰不行，鸢尾也不行。我来寻找那朵阴郁的、羞怯的、低垂、肃穆而孤绝的花……

lines.en: scene komorebi24
: Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : It could be good for her, you know.
lines.zh: : 这对她也许是好事，你知道的。

lines.en: : It could be good for you too.
lines.zh: : 对你也可能是好事。

lines.en: : Maybe she’ll become the next whatshername?
lines.zh: : 也许她会成为下一个谁谁来着？

lines.en: : You’re like me when it comes to this stuff, Aki-kun. And we both know you’ve always looked up to me.
lines.zh: : 这种事上你跟我一样，Aki 君。而且我们俩都知道，你一直都很崇拜我。

lines.en: : I won’t tell you what to do — just that you should follow {i}your{/i} heart instead of someone else’s.
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉你该怎么做——只想说，你应该遵从{i}自己{/i}的内心，而不是别人的。

lines.en: : And if you think that making love to this girl will do her more good than it will harm, I say do it.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得和这个女孩做爱对她利大于弊，那我说，去做吧。

lines.en: : You’ve always been a special boy. You can fix anything you want so long as you put your mind to it.
lines.zh: : 你一直都是个特别的男孩。只要你下定决心，你想修好什么都能修好。

lines.en: : This little one is no exception.
lines.zh: : 这个小家伙也不例外。

lines.en: : But {i}you{/i} have to make the decision, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : 但{i}你{/i}必须自己做这个决定，Aki 君。

lines.en: : It has to be {i}you{/i} this time.
lines.zh: : 这一次，必须是{i}你{/i}。
